author: bardic-inspiration
name: Sticky Floor
summary: Turns a patch of ground into a clinging morass.

stats.effect: The ground in a 15-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range becomes sticky. A creature in the area when it appears makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it has the Restrained condition until the spell ends. A creature that enters the area or ends its turn there makes the save too. Restrained creatures can use an action to repeat the save.
